title: Alavi–Boals–Chartrand–Erdős–Oellerman ascending subgraph decomposition conjecture
statement: Let $G$ be a graph with $\binom{m+1}{2}$ edges. An **ascending subgraph decomposition** is a decomposition $H_1,\ldots,H_m$ such that $H_i$ has $i$ edges and is a subgraph of $H_{i+1}$ for each $i$. **Alavi–Boals–Chartrand–Erdős–Oellerman conjecture.** Every graph $G$ with $\binom{m+1}{2}$ edges has an ascending subgraph decomposition. The paper proves this conjecture, showing in particular that such a decomposition can consist of star forests and subgraphs of complete bipartite graphs of the form $K_{t,t}$; the general conjecture is therefore solved.
source_name: Kyriakos Katsamaktsis, Shoham Letzter, Alexey Pokrovskiy and Benny Sudakov, “Ascending Subgraph Decomposition”, arXiv:2308.11613 (2023).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.11613

Status: **open** according to the source (as of August 2023). “One famous conjecture in the area that is still open and the closest to the problem we will consider here is the tree packing conjecture of Gy\'arf\'as .”
